title: Pet
description: A pet species (03-GAME-DESIGN §9; the sixteen of 06-MONSTERS.md §9): its trait, its actives (1–3, how many a pet uses is set by its grade), its stamina and stat shape, and where its eggs come from. One file per species under content/pets/<id>.json. Grade belongs to the hatched instance ($defs/petInstance) and never changes.

speciesFamilyId.description: The monster family the pet is drawn from, so eggs feel of the place (§9).

gradeBand.description: Grades this species can hatch at.

trait.description: The bloodline trait (§9: +10% gold found, ambushes −15%, +5 Detection …). It grows by use in the attribute named by growsBy.

growsBy.description: The xp tag whose meaningful uses rank the trait up (a Forage pet's Perception trait grows by finding things).

actives.description: The species' actives in unlock order (§9, 06 §9: Active 1 at pet level 5, Active 2 at 15). Grade decides how many a hatched pet may use — 1 at F–C, 2 at B–A, 3 at S+ — so a species lists as many as its gradeBand's top grade allows; the README's linter rule checks the count against gradeBand.max. The stamina cost lives on the skill record (classId 'pet').

unlockLevel.description: Pet level at which the active opens (5, 15, and the S+ third at 25 as the starting point).

stamina.description: The pet's stamina pool, refilled between fights (§9).

baseStats.description: Multipliers on the owner-level baseline (1.0 = an ordinary pet of its grade), derived stat → multiplier.

roleLean.description: The stance the species is best at; the default stance at hatch.

eggSource.description: Where its egg appears: the Pet Egg chest band and/or drops from a family (§8.3, §9).

chestBand.description: Centre grade of the Pet Egg chests that carry it; null when it never comes from a chest.

familyId.description: Monster family whose kills can drop the egg; null when none.

creationChoice.description: One of the F-grade eggs offered at creation (§2.3).

petInstance.description: A hatched pet in a hero save (§9). Grade is fixed at hatch.

ranchImport.description: Set when the pet came through the Ranch Shrine (§9); null for dungeon-born pets.
